status: pre-registered invariant temporal architecture screen; not an official competition score
purpose: test whether long-memory temporal cores learn MISATO dynamics before investing in full equivariant 3D architectures
representation: 12-dimensional per-frame rigid-motion-invariant ligand state: Rg, pair-distance statistics and step-magnitude statistics

training.objective: standardized one-step feature MSE with teacher forcing
training.parameter_policy: all models below 10k trainable parameters; exact counts must be reported

promotion.memory_signal: architecture must beat MLP on weighted rollout RMSE and beat Static in at least two scenarios
promotion.long_history_signal: must improve T2 or T3 over MLP by at least 5%
promotion.robustness: all rollout values finite and no scenario RMSE >10 standardized units
promotion.3d_next_stage: only the best passing recurrent core and Transformer enter an equivariant 3D pilot

limitations: screen predicts invariant summaries, not atomic coordinates; it is architecture evidence and cannot be reported as Geo/Phys/Dyn/Stab competition performance
